page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening). Running head at top centre; page number top left. Main text column with diagrams A, B, C, D and a multiplication sum in the middle and below; faint text of a facing column is show-through and is not transcribed. No marginal notes in a readable form.

main_text.l: [Diagrams A, B, C and D: cube and solid figures with the numbers 1000, 27, 3, 10, 90, 300, 10 and 3 printed in them, as shown below.]

l.i: Cubus igitur octo habet solida particularia in numeris,
quæ ex dati numeri partibus 10 & 3 sic constituun-
tur. Primò fiant plani quatuor, singulis partibus in se,
Hos planos si denuò ijsdem partibus multiplices, octo

page.notes: Diagram labels: A shows 1000 on the top face and 10 at the front edge; B shows 27 on top and 3 at the front; C shows 3 and 10 at the top corners and 90, 90, 90 on the faces; D shows 300, 300, 300, 10 and 3. The sum column is a multiplication layout: 10 x 10 = 100 and 3 x 3 = 9, with 30 and 30 as cross products. Some words in the second paragraph are blurred by show-through from the facing page and are uncertain. The final catchword "Eadem" is part of the last line, not a separate catchword.
